en.title: Monitoring Architecture Overview
en.purpose: Start with a service question and an inventory of devices, interfaces and responsible teams. Collection feeds normalization, time-series/event/flow storage, correlation and a response workflow. These are proposed design stages, not a required product stack.
en.evidence: Keep source identity, timestamps, observation direction and units alongside each signal. Pair state/counter observations with event context and flow attribution; one source alone is not a full service explanation.
en.boundary: Operator checklist: define missing-data handling, collector ownership and credential boundaries before adding devices. Validate supported protocols on the actual platform; this hub deploys no collectors.

zh.title: 监控架构总览
zh.purpose: 为服务问题建立设备、接口和责任团队清单。建议流程为采集、规范化、指标/事件/流量存储、关联及响应，不要求采用某个产品栈。
zh.evidence: 为每条信号保留来源标识、时间戳、方向和单位。把状态/计数器、事件上下文与流量归属关联；单一来源不能完整解释服务。
zh.boundary: 运维检查：纳管前定义缺失数据处理、采集器责任和凭据边界；在实际平台验证协议支持。本专题不部署采集器。

en.title: SNMP Polling
en.purpose: Use request/response retrieval for named management objects. GetBulk can retrieve groups of values; object definitions determine what each value means. This suits repeated state/counter observations.
en.evidence: Record object identity, response time and observation time, not only the numeric value. Pair interface octet counters with discontinuity context before treating differences as traffic.
en.boundary: Choose intervals and retry budgets from device capacity and operational needs; no universal interval is supplied. Use a supported authenticated/private SNMPv3 policy and verify implementation/security settings, rather than treating a version label as sufficient.

zh.title: SNMP 轮询
zh.purpose: 通过请求/响应读取管理对象；GetBulk可读取多项值，对象定义决定含义，适合重复获取状态与计数器。
zh.evidence: 除数值外保留对象标识、响应时间和观测时间；计算接口字节差值前检查计数器不连续信息。
zh.boundary: 按设备能力和业务需要设定间隔与重试预算，不提供通用间隔。采用平台支持的SNMPv3认证/隐私策略并验证配置，不能只看版本标签。

en.title: SNMP Trap
en.purpose: Use notifications to learn about reported transitions without waiting for the next scheduled read. SNMPv2 Trap has no protocol confirmation; an Inform requests a response. They are distinct notification behaviors.
en.evidence: Retain sender identity, notification object and received time; then check current device/interface state. A notification describes a reported event, not continuous health.
en.boundary: Operator response: test receiver reachability and planned failure events, deduplicate repeats and reconcile with polling. Silence alone must not be interpreted as proof that nothing changed.

zh.title: SNMP Trap 通知
zh.purpose: 通知可报告状态变化，无需等待下一次定期读取。SNMPv2 Trap无协议确认，而Inform请求响应，两者通知行为不同。
zh.evidence: 保留发送方、通知对象及接收时间，再核对当前设备/接口状态。通知是已报告事件，不代表连续健康观测。
zh.boundary: 响应建议：测试接收路径和计划故障、去重，并用轮询对账；不能把没有通知直接当作没有变化。

en.title: Syslog
en.purpose: Use structured device event messages to explain state changes and configuration activity. RFC5424 carries fields such as severity, timestamp and structured data; message format and transport are separate layers.
en.evidence: Correlate origin and event time with interface state or flow changes. Preserve the original message for investigation while normalizing selected fields for search.
en.boundary: Operator choices: validate clock quality, parser behavior, delivery transport and access to sensitive log fields. A severity number alone does not define service impact or the paging recipient.

zh.title: Syslog 日志
zh.purpose: 用设备事件消息解释状态与配置活动。RFC5424包含严重度、时间戳和结构化数据；消息格式与传输层相互独立。
zh.evidence: 按来源与事件时间关联接口状态或流量变化；保留原消息供调查，并规范化必要字段供检索。
zh.boundary: 运维决策：验证时钟、解析器、传输与敏感日志访问控制。严重度数字本身不能定义服务影响或通知责任人。

en.title: NetFlow
en.purpose: Use flow records to attribute observed traffic by exported keys and counters. NetFlow v9 uses templates to describe record layout; this section concerns v9, not every NetFlow version or vendor extension.
en.evidence: Check exporter identity, observation interface/direction, template availability and sampling metadata before comparing contributors. Record the exporter configuration with the report.
en.boundary: Operator review: missing templates or observation coverage can change what a collector can interpret. Exported flow records are not a complete packet capture or proof of application payload semantics.

zh.title: NetFlow 流记录
zh.purpose: 通过导出的键与计数器归属流量。NetFlow v9使用模板描述记录结构；本节仅讨论v9，不涵盖全部版本或厂商扩展。
zh.evidence: 比较贡献者前核对导出方、接口/方向、模板与采样元数据，并随报告保留导出配置。
zh.boundary: 运维复核：模板或观测覆盖缺失会影响解析。流记录不是完整抓包，也不能证明应用负载语义。

en.title: sFlow
en.purpose: sFlow combines packet sampling with counter observations. A sampled packet view helps inspect traffic mix while counter samples describe monitored interfaces; keep these evidence types separate.
en.evidence: Save sampling parameters, agent and interface identity. Label derived traffic estimates as sampled estimates and compare their measurement boundary with interface observations.
en.boundary: Operator caveat: a missing sample is not evidence that a short flow never existed. Validate hardware support and sampling configuration; do not present a sample set as an exhaustive packet history.

zh.title: sFlow 采样
zh.purpose: sFlow结合报文采样与计数器观测。报文样本用于观察流量构成，计数器样本描述受监控接口，应区分两类证据。
zh.evidence: 保存采样参数、代理和接口标识；把派生流量标为采样估计，并核对其与接口观测的边界。
zh.boundary: 运维限制：没有样本不能证明短流从未存在。应验证硬件与采样配置，不能把样本集当作完整报文历史。

en.title: IPFIX
en.purpose: IPFIX standardizes exchange of flow information between Exporting and Collecting Processes. Templates define record fields and Observation Domain scopes their interpretation.
en.evidence: Retain exporter/Observation Domain identity, templates and observation metadata together with records. Validate which Information Elements your exporter and collector actually support.
en.boundary: Operator checks: inspect transport, sequence and template handling plus loss/collector health before calling a report complete. Standards-based export does not by itself ensure identical platform feature coverage.

zh.title: IPFIX 流信息导出
zh.purpose: IPFIX规范导出进程与收集进程间的流信息交换，模板定义字段，观测域限定解释范围。
zh.evidence: 随记录保留导出方/观测域、模板和观测元数据，确认两端实际支持的信息元素。
zh.boundary: 运维检查：判断报告完整性前检查传输、序列、模板与收集器健康；标准化导出并不保证不同平台功能覆盖一致。

en.title: Streaming Telemetry
en.purpose: A subscription can deliver selected modeled paths repeatedly. OpenConfig gNMIc documents STREAM modes sample, on-change and target-defined; sample interval is a configured subscription attribute.
en.evidence: Preserve target, path, timestamp and subscription settings with observations. Define how an initial state, later updates and stale streams appear in dashboards.
en.boundary: Operator validation: negotiate supported paths/encodings and test reconnects, collector backpressure and missing updates. Streaming is not a guarantee of unlimited frequency or universal model support.

zh.title: 流式遥测
zh.purpose: 订阅可持续传送指定模型路径。OpenConfig gNMIc文档提供STREAM的sample、on-change及target-defined模式，采样间隔是订阅配置属性。
zh.evidence: 保留目标、路径、时间戳和订阅设置，明确初始状态、后续更新与过期流在看板上的展示。
zh.boundary: 运维验证：核对路径/编码支持，测试重连、采集器背压与缺失更新。流式传送不保证无限频率或通用模型支持。

en.title: API Monitoring
en.purpose: Use an authenticated data API when relevant operational objects are exposed. RESTCONF is an HTTP-based interface for YANG-defined data; read operations and error responses have explicit semantics.
en.evidence: Retain endpoint identity, schema/version, HTTP outcome and data freshness. Distinguish an empty supported dataset from authorization errors or an unavailable endpoint.
en.boundary: Operator policy: use supported read permissions, verify HTTPS identities and handle pagination/rate limits as documented by that API. A successful HTTP response is not automatically evidence that a monitored service works.

zh.title: API 监控
zh.purpose: 当平台通过认证数据API开放所需状态时可采用。RESTCONF是面向YANG数据的HTTP接口，读取与错误响应具有明确语义。
zh.evidence: 保留端点、模型/版本、HTTP结果与数据新鲜度；区分合法空集、无权限和端点不可用。
zh.boundary: 运维策略：使用支持的只读权限、验证HTTPS身份，按具体API文档处理分页/速率限制。HTTP成功并不自动证明被监控服务正常。

en.title: ICMP / Latency
en.purpose: ICMP Echo request/reply provides an IP-layer response signal. Track round-trip observations from a documented vantage point; this tests that exchange, not an application transaction.
en.evidence: Keep target, source location, packet settings and timestamps with loss/round-trip summaries. Compare observations before and after a reported event using the same probe definition.
en.boundary: Operator caveat: investigate probe reachability and policy when responses disappear; corroborate with service checks. A round trip alone does not isolate forward versus reverse path delay.

zh.title: ICMP 与时延
zh.purpose: ICMP Echo请求/响应提供IP层响应信号。从固定观测点记录往返观测，它测试该交换而非应用事务。
zh.evidence: 随丢失/往返摘要保存目标、源位置、报文设置与时间戳，事件前后使用相同探测定义比较。
zh.boundary: 运维限制：响应消失时核查探测路径与策略，并用业务检查佐证。仅往返结果不能隔离正向与反向时延。

en.title: Interface Utilization
en.purpose: Interface counters describe a specific interface/sub-layer. RFC2863 defines high-capacity octet counters and discontinuity context; choose comparable successive observations before deriving rates.
en.evidence: Arithmetic definition: rate bit/s = 8 × octet difference ÷ elapsed seconds; utilization % = rate ÷ documented capacity ×100. Handle resets/discontinuities before subtraction; preserve direction and actual elapsed time.
en.boundary: Operator review: inspect errors/discards and member-level distribution alongside aggregate load. A long average can hide shorter changes; capacity and measurement layer must match. No universal safe utilization threshold is defined here.

zh.title: 接口利用率
zh.purpose: 接口计数器对应特定接口/子层。RFC2863定义高容量字节计数器与不连续信息，应选择可比较的连续观测后再派生速率。
zh.evidence: 算术定义：速率bit/s＝8×字节差÷经过秒数；利用率%＝速率÷已记录容量×100。相减前处理重置/不连续，并保留方向及真实间隔。
zh.boundary: 运维复核：总负载之外查看错误/丢弃及成员分布。长平均可能掩盖短变化，容量与计量层必须匹配。本专题不定义通用安全利用率。

en.title: CPU / Memory
en.purpose: Interpret resource values using their object definitions. HOST-RESOURCES-MIB defines processor load over a stated interval and storage entries with type, allocation units, size and used values.
en.evidence: Capture object/vendor model and time window with each series. Distinguish memory pools and storage types before constructing a used percentage; avoid comparing unlike denominators.
en.boundary: Operator response: correlate resource changes with routing churn, configuration activity and collector gaps, then follow platform diagnostics. Do not infer a universal fault percentage or treat every device as implementing this MIB.

zh.title: CPU 与内存
zh.purpose: 按对象定义解释资源数值。HOST-RESOURCES-MIB规定处理器负载的观测区间，以及存储条目的类型、分配单位、总量和已用量。
zh.evidence: 随序列记录对象/厂商模型和时间窗口。计算已用百分比前区分内存池与存储类型，避免比较不同分母。
zh.boundary: 运维响应：关联路由变化、配置活动及采集缺口，再按平台流程诊断。不能推定通用故障百分比，也不能假设所有设备实现该MIB。

en.title: Optical Power Monitoring
en.purpose: Read optical values with units, scale, status and freshness. Cisco ASR900 DOM documentation is a vendor/platform-specific example exposing transmit/receive power and other transceiver parameters with warning/alarm tables.
en.evidence: Record optic model, port/lane, supported sensor and both endpoints where available. Sensor identity and update context help distinguish unavailable readings from a low measured value.
en.boundary: Operator review: use the actual optic/platform specifications and calibration context, then correlate with errors and link state. No fixed dBm limit is transferred across optics. Verify DOM support; the cited platform has documented operational limits.

zh.title: 光功率监控
zh.purpose: 读取光学值时保留单位、缩放、状态和新鲜度。Cisco ASR900 DOM文档是厂商/平台特定示例，提供收发光功率等参数及预警/告警表。
zh.evidence: 在可用时记录模块型号、端口/通道、受支持传感器及两端值。通过传感器标识和更新时间区分无法获取与实际低读数。
zh.boundary: 运维复核：使用实际模块/平台规格与校准上下文，关联错误和链路状态。不能跨模块套用固定dBm阈值；应核对DOM支持及所引平台文档限制。

en.title: Alert Design
en.purpose: Separate event arrival from an actionable alarm lifecycle. RFC8632 identifies alarms by resource/type and distinguishes alarm state/severity from operator management; delivery alone is not the response process.
en.evidence: Proposed runbook fields: resource, service impact evidence, owner, corroborating signal, acknowledgement, recovery check and escalation path. Keep maintenance suppression auditable and distinguish missing data from recovery.
en.boundary: Operator policy: choose thresholds, persistence and hysteresis from your service objectives and observed baseline, then test detection and recovery. This hub provides no fixed paging threshold or automated severity score.

zh.title: 告警设计
zh.purpose: 区分事件到达与可行动告警生命周期。RFC8632按资源/类型识别告警，并区分状态/严重度与人员管理；消息送达不等于响应闭环。
zh.evidence: 建议流程字段：资源、业务影响证据、责任人、佐证信号、确认、恢复检查及升级路径。维护抑制须可追溯，区分无数据与恢复。
zh.boundary: 运维策略：根据业务目标与观测基线选择阈值、持续时间和迟滞，测试触发及恢复。本专题不提供固定通知阈值或自动严重度评分。

en.title: Monitoring Data Retention
en.purpose: Retention is an operator/data-governance decision, not a universal protocol duration. Decide which questions require raw events/flow records and which can use aggregated trends before selecting storage tiers.
en.evidence: Proposed worksheet: dataset, owner, resolution, access group, investigation/growth horizon, deletion rule and restore test. Keep exporter/schema context with retained records; avoid storing identifiers without a defined need.
en.boundary: Operator trade-off: aggregation changes what later questions can be answered; document the transformation and validate representative queries. Choose duration from incident review, capacity planning, privacy obligations and actual storage budget; no fixed days are prescribed.

zh.title: 监控数据保留
zh.purpose: 保留期限属于运维及数据治理决策，不是协议统一规定。选存储层前先区分哪些问题需要原始事件/流记录，哪些可使用聚合趋势。
zh.evidence: 建议台账：数据集、责任人、分辨率、访问组、调查/增长时间范围、删除规则及恢复测试。随记录保留导出/模型上下文，避免无必要存储标识。
zh.boundary: 运维权衡：聚合会改变后续可回答的问题，应记录变换并验证代表性查询。按事件复盘、容量规划、隐私要求及实际预算选择期限，不规定固定天数。

en.title: Related Tools
en.purpose: Use the Application Bandwidth Analyzer for a manual snapshot of mutually exclusive application rates against a supplied link capacity. It does not collect NetFlow, poll SNMP or discover applications.
en.evidence: Use the existing capacity forecast planner after selecting a representative aggregate observation and explicit growth assumptions. Transfer-time planning is another existing workflow, not a substitute for measurement.
en.boundary: Resource links below are verified existing pages. The five additional monitoring capabilities listed later are planned data only, without pages, tool IDs or production labels.

zh.title: 相关工具
zh.purpose: 应用带宽分析器把互不重叠的手工应用速率与给定容量比较，不采集NetFlow、不轮询SNMP，也不发现应用。
zh.evidence: 选择代表性总量与明确增长假设后可使用现有容量预测工具。现有传输时间规划是另一流程，不能替代测量。
zh.boundary: 下方资源均为已核实页面。后列五项监控能力仅是计划数据，没有页面、工具ID或生产状态。

en.title: Related Courses
en.purpose: No appropriate published course was verified in this scoped repository inventory. The following is an in-hub learning sequence, not a course enrollment or a claim that a course exists.
en.evidence: Learning route: define a service question; compare SNMP observations and notifications; add event/flow evidence; inspect units and gaps; build an alert runbook; then plan retention. Open the existing switching-capacity guide for a concrete related reading.
en.boundary: Practice with the worked example on this page. Verify each signal and its failure mode on a permitted test device before applying a monitoring design to production.

zh.title: 相关课程
zh.purpose: 本次定向仓库盘点未核实可用的对应课程。以下是专题内学习顺序，不是课程报名，也不声称已有课程。
zh.evidence: 学习路线：定义服务问题、比较SNMP观测与通知、加入事件/流量证据、核对单位与缺口、编写告警流程、规划保留。现有交换机容量指南可作为相关阅读。
zh.boundary: 可用本页示例练习。在获准的测试设备验证信号及其失效方式后，再将监控设计用于生产。

en.title: Related Troubleshooting Cases
en.purpose: No dedicated monitoring troubleshooting case or interactive lab was verified as an existing resource. The LACP member-congestion guide is an available related diagnostic guide, not a new Case or Lab.
en.evidence: Suggested check sequence: confirm collection freshness and permissions; identify affected service/interface; compare current state with events; inspect member load/errors; use flow context to narrow contributors; verify recovery with the original service test.
en.boundary: A missing signal can be a collection failure. Preserve evidence and separate observation from diagnosis; this hub does not assert a root cause for a live incident.

zh.title: 相关排障案例
zh.purpose: 未核实已有专门监控排障案例或交互实验。LACP成员拥塞指南是可用的相关诊断指南，不是新建Case或Lab。
zh.evidence: 建议检查顺序：确认数据新鲜度与权限、确定受影响业务/接口、对照状态与事件、检查成员负载/错误、通过流信息缩小贡献者范围、用原业务测试确认恢复。
zh.boundary: 缺失信号可能源于采集故障。保留证据并区分观测与诊断；本专题不为实际事件断言根因。

en.title: Worked architecture: branch users report slow backups
steps: Question: is the WAN busy, and which observed traffic contributes? Define one egress interface, service owner and common time window.

Signals: collect comparable interface counters/state; add configured flow export for contributor context and syslog/notifications for transitions. Record exporter, direction, units, clocks and collection gaps.
Correlation: align the slowdown window with utilization and top observed contributors. Check member distribution and errors before assuming aggregate load explains the symptom.
Response: an operator-owned runbook requests corroborating service evidence, assigns the link/service owner and repeats the same service test after remediation. No fixed trigger is implied.

Retention assumption: keep enough appropriate-resolution evidence for your incident review and capacity trend horizon under the approved privacy/access/deletion policy. Validate that queries survive aggregation.

Follow-up: copy compatible manually observed rates into the Application Bandwidth Analyzer; then use explicit growth assumptions in the existing forecast planner. The hub does not collect or calculate these observations.

zh.title: 架构示例：分支用户反映备份变慢
steps: 问题：广域链路是否繁忙，哪些已观测流量有贡献？确定一个出方向接口、业务责任人及统一时间窗口。
信号：采集可比较的接口计数器/状态，加入已配置流导出以识别贡献者，用日志/通知记录变化。保留导出方、方向、单位、时钟及采集缺口。
关联：将变慢窗口与利用率、主要已观测贡献者对齐；检查成员分布和错误后再判断总负载能否解释症状。
响应：由运维定义流程，要求业务佐证、指定链路/业务责任人，并在处理后重复相同业务测试。不预设固定触发阈值。
保留假设：按批准的隐私、访问和删除策略，为事件复盘与容量趋势保留适当分辨率证据，验证聚合后查询仍有效。
后续：把兼容的手工观测速率输入应用带宽分析器，再以明确增长假设使用现有预测工具。本专题不采集或计算观测数据。
